bullets: On Monday 23 November, DLD recorded 753 sales worth AED 2.3bn, which is 0.5% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 57.8% of Monday's sales, compared to 59.8% over the last 7 days.
The median price was AED 1,751 per sq ft, up 3.6% from the 30-day average and down 3.6% from last year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas were JVC with 208 sales, Business Bay with 145 sales, and Dubai South (DWC) with 113 sales.
In October new rental contracts, JVC 1BR apartments had a median of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Dubai property prices recently reached a four-year high amid new supply, highlighting key price milestones and upcoming inventory pressures.
Dubai rents have dropped up to 15 percent in key neighborhoods, directly affecting leasing yields and tenant affordability.
New apartment rents in Dubai dropped 9 percent, adjusting rental rates and affecting tenant affordability and landlord yields.
